data.config.yml:
runner:
  file: '.runner'
  capacity: 2
  envs:
    DOCKER_HOST: 'tcp://localhost:2376'
    DOCKER_TLS_VERIFY: '1'
    DOCKER_CERT_PATH: '/certs/client'
    CI_CPU_QUOTA: '8'
  timeout: '3h'
  shutdown_timeout: '10m'
  labels:
    - 'docker-cli:docker://data.forgejo.org/oci/docker:28.5-cli'
    - 'node:docker://data.forgejo.org/oci/node:20.19'
    - 'ci-base:docker://data.forgejo.org/oci/gastown-runner:go1.27-node20'
container:
  network: 'host'
  options: '--add-host=forgejo:10.43.130.32 --init -v ci-gomod:/home/ci/go -v ci-gocache:/home/ci/.cache/go-build -v ci-npm:/home/ci/.npm -v /certs/client:/certs/client'
  valid_volumes:
    - 'ci-gomod'
    - 'ci-gocache'
    - 'ci-npm'
    - '/certs/client'
